landing.text:
HEADLINE
Make informed people decisions

SUBHEADLINE
For mid-size HR VPs, a focused tool to move beyond complex data sets.

WHAT THIS IS
A tool that helps mid-size HR VPs make informed people decisions by moving from don't want to wade through complex data sets.

WHO IT IS FOR
Mid-size HR VPs

THE PROBLEM
Wading through complex data sets slows decision-making.

WHY EXISTING TOOLS FAIL
Spreadsheets were designed for broader categories, not mid-size HR VPs' specific needs, forcing manual workarounds that slow outcomes.

HOW IT WORKS
Provides actionable insights without overwhelming data.

KEY BENEFITS
Early users reach their first outcome faster with our HR analytics dashboard compared to general-purpose alternatives.

CALL TO ACTION
Get started with HR analytics dashboard.

UX CONTEXT
TARGET: product
HR analytics dashboard helps mid-size hr vps go from don't want to wade through complex data sets to make informed people decisions.

ONBOARDING
1. Define who HR analytics dashboard is for and the problem it solves.
2. Shape your core message so HR analytics dashboard can tailor output.
3. Generate your first result and refine as you go.

EMPTY STATE
1. No audience defined yet. Start by telling HR analytics dashboard who you're building for.
2. No message saved yet. Build your setup to generate output.
3. No output yet. Generate your first result.

ERROR
1. That did not save. Check your input and try again.
2. That step did not complete. Make sure all required fields are filled in.
3. This action failed. Reload and try again, or contact support if it continues.

TOAST
1. Saved. Your progress is recorded.
2. Done. Continue when you are ready.
3. Brain saved. Output ready.

BUTTON LABELS
1. Build Brain
2. Review Brain
3. Generate Positioning
4. Generate Landing
5. Generate UX
6. Refine Message
7. Compare Outputs
8. Save Brain
